preconditions.description: Attacker must hold MVK tokens to trigger transfer functions that may call swapAndLiquify
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true to trigger swapAndLiquify during transfers
Contract must have accumulated sufficient tokens in its balance to trigger swap (above minTokensBeforeSwap)
Contract must have BNB balance for reward claims or marketing transfers

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract with receive() fallback function. Step 1: Acquire MVK tokens. Step 2: Trigger transfer() to your malicious contract which will call swapAndLiquify if conditions are met. Step 3: During the external call in swapTokensForEth() to PancakeRouter or marketingwallet.transfer(), re-enter the contract via transfer() or claimReward(). Step 4: In claimReward(), the BNB transfer occurs before UserrewardPoolOnLastClaim is updated, allowing multiple claims. Step 5: Drain BNB from reward pool or marketing funds through repeated reentrant calls before state variables are properly updated.
